verses.text: Haton stzolal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Adán tik: Winhaj Set, winhaj Enós,
winhaj Cainán, winhaj Mahalaleel, winhaj Jared,
winhaj Enoc, winhaj Matusalén, winhaj Lamec,
winhaj Noé. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Noé: Haton winhaj Sem, winhaj Cam yet' winhaj Jafet.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jafet chi': Winhaj Gomer, winhaj Magog, winhaj Madai, winhaj Javán, winhaj Tubal, winhaj Mesec yet' winhaj Tiras.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Gomer chi': Winhaj Askenaz, winhaj Rifat yet' winhaj Togarma.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Javán chi': Haton winhaj Elisa, winhaj Tarsis, winhaj Quitim yet' winhaj Dodanim.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Cam: Haton winhaj Cus, winhaj Mizraim, winhaj Fut, winhaj Canaán.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Cus chi': Haton winhaj Seba, winhaj Havila, winhaj Sabta, winhaj Raama yet' winhaj Sabteca. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Raama chi': Haton winhaj Seba yet' winhaj Dedán.
Ha winhaj Cus chi', haton winh smam winhaj Nimrod. Haton jun winh chi' te niwan ajnak yelk'och t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik yujto te jelan ajnak winh t'a owal.
Ha t'a winhaj Mizraim, hata' kotnak heb' ludeo, heb' anameo, heb' lehabita, heb' naftuhítas,
heb' patruseo, heb' casluhítas yet' heb' caftoritas. Ha t'a heb' chi' kotnak yinhtil heb' filisteo.
Ha winhaj Sidón, b'ab'el yuninal winhaj Canaán. Ha junxo yuninal winh, haton winhaj Het.
Ha winhaj Canaán chi' ay yinhtilal heb' jebuseo, heb' amorreo, heb' gergeseo,
heb' heveo, heb' araceo, heb' sineo,
heb' arvadeo, heb' zemareo yet' heb' hamateo.

Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Sem: Haton winhaj Elam, winhaj Asur, winhaj Arfaxad, winhaj Lud yet' winhaj Aram. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Aram chi': Haton winhaj Uz, winhaj Hul, winhaj Geter yet' winhaj Mesec.
Ha winhaj Arfaxad chi' smam winhaj Sela, haxo winhaj Sela chi' smam winhaj Heber.
Ha winhaj Heber chi', chawanh yuninal winh: Ha winh b'ab'el skuch Peleg, yujto ha t'a stiempo'al winh ix pojchajb'at lum lum. Haxo junxo winh yuninal winh chi' skuchan Joctán.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Joctán chi': Haton winhaj Almodad, winhaj Selef, winhaj Hazar-mawet, winhaj Jera,
winhaj Adoram, winhaj Uzal, winhaj Dicla,
winhaj Ebal, winhaj Abimael, winhaj Seba,
winhaj Ofir, winhaj Havila yet' winhaj Jobab. Ha masanil heb' winh tik, yuninal heb' winh winhaj Joctán.
Haton sb'i heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Sem tik t'a stzolal: Winhaj Arfaxad, winhaj Sela,
winhaj Heber, winhaj Peleg, winhaj Reu,
winhaj Serug, winhaj Nacor, winhaj Taré,
yet' winhaj Abram, haton winhaj Abraham.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Abraham: Haton winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Ismael.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ismael: Haton winhaj Nebaiot, b'ab'el yuninal, winhaj Cedar, winhaj Adbeel, winhaj Mibsam,
winhaj Misma, winhaj Duma, winhaj Massa, winhaj Hadad, winhaj Tema,
winhaj Jetur, winhaj Nafis yet' winhaj Cedema.

Haxo heb' yune' ix Cetura, schab'il yetb'eyum winhaj Abraham chi': Haton winhaj Zimram, winhaj Jocsán, winhaj Medán, winhaj Madián, winhaj Isbac yet' winhaj Súa. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jocsán chi': Haton winhaj Seba yet' winhaj Dedán.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Madián chi': Haton winhaj Efa, winhaj Efer, winhaj Hanoc, winhaj Abida yet' winhaj Elda. Masanil heb' winh tik, yinhtilal heb' winh ix Cetura.
Ha winhaj Abraham smam winhaj Isaac. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Isaac chi', haton winhaj Esaú yet' winhaj Israel.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Esaú chi': Haton winhaj Elifaz, winhaj Reuel, winhaj Jeús, winhaj Jaalam yet' winhaj Coré.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Elifaz chi': Haton winhaj Temán, winhaj Omar, winhaj Zefo, winhaj Gatam, winhaj Cenaz yet' winhaj Amalec yune' ix Timna.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Reuel chi': Haton winhaj Nahat, winhaj Zera, winhaj Sama yet' winhaj Miza.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Seir: Haton winhaj Lotán, winhaj Sobal, winhaj Zibeón, winhaj Aná, winhaj Disón, winhaj Ezer yet' winhaj Disán.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Lotán chi': Haton winhaj Hori yet' winhaj Homam. Ha winhaj Lotán chi' ay yanab' ix Timna.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Sobal chi': Haton winhaj Alván, winhaj Manahat, winhaj Ebal, winhaj Sefo yet' winhaj Onam. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Zibeón chi': Haton winhaj Aja yet' winhaj Aná.
Ha winhaj Aná chi', smam winhaj Disón, haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Disón chi': Haton winhaj Amram, winhaj Esbán, winhaj Itrán yet' winhaj Querán.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ezer: Haton winhaj Bilhán, winhaj Zaaván yet' winhaj Jaacán. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Disán chi': Haton winhaj Uz yet' winhaj Arán.
Haton heb' winh tik ix ak'an yajalil t'a Edom ayik mantalaj sreyal heb' israel tz'ochi: Ha winhaj Bela yuninal winhaj Beor, Dinaba sb'i schonhab' winh.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Bela chi', haxo winhaj Jobab yuninal winhaj Zera, aj chonhab' Bosra ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Haxo yik ix cham winhaj Jobab chi', haxo winhaj Husam ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ha jun winh chi', ha t'a yol yik Temán kajan winh.
Haxo yik ix cham winhaj Husam chi', haxo winhaj Hadad yuninal winhaj Bedad aj chonhab' Avit ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ha jun winh chi' ix ak'an ganar winhaj Madián t'a ak'lik yik Moab.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Hadad chi', haxo winhaj Samla aj chonhab' Masreca ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Samla chi', haxo winhaj Saúl ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. kajan winh t'a chonhab' Rehobot t'a sti' ha' Éufrates.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Saúl chi', haxo winhaj Baal-hanán, yuninal winhaj Acbor ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Baal-hanán chi', haxo winhaj Hadad aj chonhab' Pai ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Mehetabel sb'i ix yetb'eyum winh, a winhaj Matred ay yisil ix, yixchikin ix winhaj Mezaab.
Haxo yik ix cham winhaj Hadad chi', a heb' winh ix och reyal t'a Edom chi': Haton winhaj Timna, winhaj Alva, winhaj Jetet,
winhaj Aholibama, winhaj Ela, winhaj Pinón,
winhaj Cenaz, winhaj Temán, winhaj Mibzar,
winhaj Magdiel yet' winhaj Iram. Haton juntzanh heb' winh tik ix ak'an reyal t'a Edom chi'.
